newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber mostly weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber mostly weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly weaker in lacklustre after-hours trade on Wednesday after drifting sideways during the day, traders said.
The benchmark February contract, which was up 0.3 yen per kg from the day's close, was supported by trade houses' buying.
Other contracts ranged from 0.4 yen lower to unchanged.
Amid a lack of fresh factors, private investors generally stood on the sidelines ahead of the spot expiry on Sept 24.
During the day, an increase in Japan's rubber stocks announced in the afternoon session put downward pressure on nearby prices, they said.
